title: Deep Zoom
blurb: Dive past 10⁻¹⁰⁰ into the Mandelbrot set to hunt a hidden period-120 minibrot. One 512-bit BigInt reference orbit feeds a WebGL2 Floatexp perturbation shader with Zhuoran rebasing; drag the split curtain to watch direct IEEE float32 shatter into giant tiles at 10⁻⁷, or click Verify to check 25 live pixels against 512-bit truth.
